summary: Golden Heaven Group's wholly owned Nanping Golden Carnival subsidiary signed three asset acquisition agreements on September 24, 2026 with Guangxi Senguang Entertainment Investment to buy amusement-park assets — fixed assets, intangibles and project contracts — tied to Yixing Qinglongshan Happy World, Nanning Caribbean Water World and Lishui Xingzhuang Park Children's Amusement Park. Aggregate purchase price is RMB139,945,792.52 across the three parks. Each deal pays 50% within five business days of signing, the balance within five business days of completed asset delivery and ownership transfer; terms are asset purchases, not equity, with valuation supported by third-party appraisal. Watch asset-transfer completion and funding.
